name: 01-platform-host
title: The platform host
description: Take the physical lab host from bare Ubuntu 24.04 + SSH to the platform the seven-VM estate stands on: nested virtualisation enabled and gated fail-fast, sysctl tuning, the KVM/libvirt/cloud-image toolchain, the lab ed25519 keypair, the lab and iso storage pools, the noble cloud image fetched, and the estate snapshot/revert scripts installed.
source: Generated from runbooks/lab/lab-host.yaml in the MatrixClaw lab repository. That runbook built this phase of the real 32 GB estate on 20-21 July 2026; the run records hold every command's exit code and output.
honesty: Steps change this machine and are gated. Each carries an 'already' probe, so a re-run skips what is done rather than repeating it. Checks are read-only and carry exact-match markers so they cannot pass on their own error text.

steps.title: Nested virt enable
steps.run:
if grep -q vmx /proc/cpuinfo; then M=kvm_intel; else M=kvm_amd; fi
echo "options $M nested=1" | sudo tee /etc/modprobe.d/kvm-lab.conf
sudo modprobe -r $M || true
sudo modprobe $M
cat /sys/module/$M/parameters/nested

steps.title: Nested virt gate
steps.run: grep -qE '[Y1]' /sys/module/kvm_intel/parameters/nested /sys/module/kvm_amd/parameters/nested 2>/dev/null && echo NESTED-VIRT-OK || (echo 'FATAL: nested virtualisation is OFF - enable VT-x/VT-d in BIOS and re-plan' && exit 1)

steps.title: Sysctl lab tuning
steps.run:
sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/99-cloudstack-lab.conf > /dev/null << 'EOF'
net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1
vm.swappiness = 10
fs.aio-max-nr = 1048576
EOF
sudo sysctl -p /etc/sysctl.d/99-cloudstack-lab.conf

steps.title: Kvm libvirt stack
steps.run: sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -q && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -q qemu-kvm libvirt-daemon-system libvirt-clients virtinst qemu-utils libguestfs-tools cloud-image-utils chrony && sudo systemctl enable --now chrony && sudo usermod -aG libvirt,kvm $USER
steps.already: dpkg -s virtinst 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok.installed && dpkg -s cloud-image-utils 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok.installed && id -nG $USER | grep -qw libvirt && id -nG $USER | grep -qw kvm

steps.title: Storage pools
steps.run:
sudo mkdir -p /data/lab /data/iso
sudo chown $USER: /data/lab /data/iso
sg libvirt -c '
export LIBVIRT_DEFAULT_URI=qemu:///system
for p in lab iso; do
  virsh pool-define-as $p dir --target /data/$p
  virsh pool-build $p
  virsh pool-start $p
  virsh pool-autostart $p
done
virsh pool-list'
steps.already: sg libvirt -c "export LIBVIRT_DEFAULT_URI=qemu:///system; virsh pool-list | grep -q 'lab .*active' && virsh pool-list | grep -q 'iso .*active'"

steps.title: Fetch cloud image
steps.run: sudo chown $USER: /data/lab /data/iso && cd /data/iso && wget -c https://cloud-images.ubuntu.com/noble/current/noble-server-cloudimg-amd64.img && qemu-img info noble-server-cloudimg-amd64.img

steps.title: Install lab snapshot script
steps.run:
tee ~/lab-snapshot.sh > /dev/null << 'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export LIBVIRT_DEFAULT_URI=qemu:///system
VMS="mgmt-01 ceph-01 ceph-02 ceph-03 kvm-01 kvm-02 nfs-01"
SNAP=${1:-baseline}
for vm in $VMS; do virsh shutdown $vm 2>/dev/null || true; done
echo "Waiting for clean shutdowns..."
while virsh list --name | grep -qE 'mgmt|ceph|kvm|nfs'; do sleep 5; done
for vm in $VMS; do virsh snapshot-create-as $vm "$SNAP"; done
for vm in $VMS; do virsh start $vm; done
echo "Snapshot '$SNAP' taken across the estate; everything restarting."
EOF
chmod +x ~/lab-snapshot.sh

steps.title: Install lab revert script
steps.run:
tee ~/lab-revert.sh > /dev/null << 'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export LIBVIRT_DEFAULT_URI=qemu:///system
VMS="mgmt-01 ceph-01 ceph-02 ceph-03 kvm-01 kvm-02 nfs-01"
SNAP=${1:-baseline}
for vm in $VMS; do virsh destroy $vm 2>/dev/null || true; done
for vm in $VMS; do virsh snapshot-revert $vm "$SNAP"; done
for vm in $VMS; do virsh start $vm; done
echo "Estate reverted to '$SNAP' and restarting — allow a few minutes to settle."
EOF
chmod +x ~/lab-revert.sh

checks.title: Lab pool active
checks.run: export LIBVIRT_DEFAULT_URI=qemu:///system; virsh pool-list | grep -q 'lab .*active' && echo LAB-POOL-ACTIVE

checks.title: Iso pool active
checks.run: export LIBVIRT_DEFAULT_URI=qemu:///system; virsh pool-list | grep -q 'iso .*active' && echo ISO-POOL-ACTIVE
